headline: Goa Police Defend CJP Detentions
summary: Goa Police justified before the High Court the detention of seven CJP members, citing a history of unauthorized protests. The Bombay High Court later ordered the release of the protesters.

headline: Umar Khalid Support Cited in Protest Denial
summary: Goa police denied protest permission to CJP members, citing their past support for Umar Khalid. The denial led to demonstrations and subsequent detentions near Azad Maidan.

headline: Goa Sizzles Amid High Temperatures
summary: Deficient rainfall and anticyclonic circulation have pushed Goa's temperatures above 36°C, with Panaji recording 37.2°C, its hottest October day in nearly 20 years. Hot and humid weather is expected to persist until October 15.

headline: Revanth Reddy Attacks BJP in Goa
summary: Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy criticized the BJP during an electoral event in Goa, comparing the party to 'Ravan' and accusing it of turning the state into a hub for drug peddlers.

headline: Two Booked for IIT Goa Exam Fraud
summary: CISF personnel at an airport screening caught two individuals carrying Bluetooth earpieces and SIM cards to cheat in the IIT Goa recruitment exam. Police have registered cases against the suspects.

headline: Stray Dog Relocation Plan Opposed
summary: The tourism department's proposal to relocate stray dogs from beaches ahead of the tourist season has drawn opposition. Meanwhile, the Chief Minister assured there will be no stray dog menace on beaches.

headline: Waste Plant Cuts Intake by a Third
summary: The Saligao waste treatment plant has suspended or reduced its waste intake from several local bodies and villages for 25 days. The temporary cut has affected waste management operations across multiple regions.

headline: KORE Mobile Opens New Store
summary: KORE Mobile has launched a new store in Goa, offering genuine mobile devices, expert guidance, and promotional vehicle prizes for customers. The retail expansion aims to tap into the local electronics market.

headline: Canacona Hit by Water Pipeline Burst
summary: Sudden pipeline bursts have disrupted the water supply, leaving three areas in Canacona completely without water. Local authorities are working to repair the damaged infrastructure.

headline: Churchill Bros Upset Mumbai City
summary: Churchill Brothers pulled off an impressive victory against Mumbai City during their debut match in the Indian Super League (ISL). The upset marked a strong start for the Goan side in the tournament.
